summary: Petition under Sections 17(3) & 17(4) of the Electricity Act seeking approval for creation of security interest over the Petitioner's assets in favour of Respondent No. 3 (who is acting as the security trustee for the purpose of holding the securities on behalf of and for benefit of the lenders in terms of the Security Trustee Agreement dated 23.12.2024) (including its Assignees, Transferees, Novates) in respect of the Petitioner's Transmission Project. New Delhi-110021. **Petitioner** 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation and perfection of a Security Interest in terms of the Financing Document through the mortgage, hypothecation, charge, or assignment over rights, title, interest, claims, demands, benefits under, clearance, project documents, agreements, and approvals (with the exception of security over the fixed assets) of the Petitioner in favour of the SBICAP Trustee Company Limited (Respondent No. 3). Additionally, the Petitioner has requested for the approval of documents that create security as well as other documents pertaining to the debenture facility. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _“(a) Approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation /mortgage/ charge/ pledge/assignment (as applicable), over all assets including the assets listed at Paragraph 14 above, and all the movable and immovable assets, Transmission Project accounts, Project Documents (including assignment of transmission licence) etc., both present and future, of Petitioner in terms of the Financing Documents, or as may be agreed between the Petitioner and the Lender from time to time, in favour of Lender /_ _(b) Pass any or such further orders as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ 5. The Petitioner has further submitted that the Loan Agreement was executed in relation to the Project Facility, which has been agreed to be extended by the 6. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Loan Agreement, - a) All the right, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in the Project Documents duly acknowledged and consented to by the relevant counter-parties to such Project Documents, all as amended, varied or supplemented from time to time; - b) The right, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in, to and under all the Clearances pertaining to the Project; - c) The right, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in, to and under the Transmission License; e) All the right, title, interest, benefits, claims, and demands whatsoever of the Borrower under all Insurance Contracts. 7. The Petitioner has submitted that in terms of the Financing Documents, the Petitioner is required to create security, which is the transaction security (as defined under the Financing Agreements), in favour of a Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender. 8. The Petitioner has stated that Article 15.2.2 of the Transmission Service Agreement entered into between the Petitioner and the beneficiaries of the project provides that the Petitioner is free to create any encumbrance over all or part of the receivables, Letter of Credit, or other assets of the project in favour of the lenders or the representative of the lenders as security for the amount payable under the Financing Agreements and any other amounts agreed by the parties. The Petitioner has submitted that in terms of Article 15 of the TSA, the Petitioner is required to take permission from the Commission prior to relinquishing or transferring its rights and obligations in the TSA. 10. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 21.5.2025 after notice to the Respondents. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing on 21.5.2025, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. 11. During the course of the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that as the Respondents were granted an opportunity to file their replies, vide RoP dated 21.5.2025. However, no reply has been filed by the Respondents. None was present on behalf of the Respondent during the hearing on 7.7.2025, despite notice. Considering the submissions of the parties, the matter was reserved for orders. _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ 23. In the event of a default by the licensee regarding debt repayment, the Commission may, upon a joint application submitted by the licensee, lender, Security Trustee, and nominee, grant approval for the assignment of the licence to a nominee, contingent upon the satisfactory completion of due diligence procedures. Consequently, it is imperative to obtain explicit prior approval from the Commission for the assignment of the licence to the nominee of the Security Trustee or for the transfer of any assets to them. Finally, the Petitioner is required to submit the financial documents and statements in accordance with the directives issued by the Commission.
title: Petition under Sections 17(3) & 17(4) of the Electricity Act seeking approval for creation of security interest over the Petitioner's assets in favour of Respondent No. 3 (who is acting as the security trustee for the purpose of holding the securities on behalf of and for benefit of the lenders in terms of the Security Trustee Agreement dated 23.12.2024) (including its Assignees, Transferees, Novates) in respect of the Petitioner's Transmission Project.
